name: MiqorAI
description: MiqorAI monorepo — run all web frontends together

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,patient,hospital,insurance,pharmacy,admin -c red,blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev -w patient-portal-desktop" "npm run dev -w hospital-portal" "npm run dev -w insurance-portal" "npm run dev -w pharmacy-portal" "npm run dev -w admin-portal"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n patient,hospital,insurance,pharmacy,admin -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w patient-portal-desktop" "npm run dev -w hospital-portal" "npm run dev -w insurance-portal" "npm run dev -w pharmacy-portal" "npm run dev -w admin-portal"
scripts.dev:core: node scripts/ensure-redis.mjs && concurrently -k -n api,patient,hospital -c red,blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev -w patient-portal-desktop" "npm run dev -w hospital-portal"
scripts.dev:full: node scripts/ensure-redis.mjs && concurrently -k -n api,patient,hospital,insurance,pharmacy,admin -c red,blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev -w patient-portal-desktop" "npm run dev -w hospital-portal" "npm run dev -w insurance-portal" "npm run dev -w pharmacy-portal" "npm run dev -w admin-portal"
scripts.build: npm run build -w patient-portal-desktop -w hospital-portal -w insurance-portal -w pharmacy-portal -w admin-portal
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w patient-portal-desktop -w hospital-portal -w insurance-portal -w pharmacy-portal -w admin-portal
scripts.test:api: npm run db:seed --prefix server && npm test --prefix server
scripts.verify: npm run test:api && npm run build:all
